Implemented Linux Dot hero layout clamping so the centered pulsing dot never overlaps the (optional) Artist/Song overlay, even with long metadata at normal and maximum text sizes—while preserving Dot’s persistent `showSongInfo` default-off behavior.

### Code change
- **`lib/widgets/heroes/dot_hero.dart`**
  - When `config.showSongInfo == true`, the dot radius is clamped based on an estimated worst-case height of `HeroTitleBlock` (2 lines per heading + spacing), ensuring the dot stays below the overlay inside the hero band.

### Screenshots (Dot hero + showSongInfo ON)
Fixture played: `/opt/nothingness/media/01-undercover-49.opus`

- **Normal text size (textScale = 1.0)**  
  `/workspace/.tmp/agent_shots/dot_textscale_normal.png`
- **Maximum text size (textScale = 1.5)**  
  `/workspace/.tmp/agent_shots/dot_textscale_max.png`
